'''Cana''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When Anchorhead was the target of terrorist attacks using bomb-carrying local [[Droid/Legends|droids]], Cana rushed to help her injured neighbor [[Benett]], and the two were defended from additional droids by [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="TOR" />
